purpose: Test whether structured width plus stateful shared FFN computation improves composition beyond dense width reduction or ordinary looping. Development screen only; confirm on fresh seeds and language datasets.

variants.name: full-swiglu
variants.hypothesis: Full conventional gated FFN quality reference.

variants.name: blockshuffle
variants.hypothesis: Structured width helps beyond narrowing at equal FFN parameters and projection work.

variants.name: blockshuffle-loop2
variants.hypothesis: Stateful composition improves the structured block without additional weights.

variants.name: blockshuffle-loop4
variants.hypothesis: Additional refinement helps or saturates; four passes exceed full-SwiGLU projection work.

variants.name: narrow-loop2
variants.hypothesis: Control for ordinary weight sharing at the same parameters and loop count.

variants.name: narrow-loop4
variants.hypothesis: Control for ordinary weight sharing at four passes.

variants.name: dense-compute2
variants.hypothesis: Single-pass dense control with the same FFN projection work as two structured passes; parameter count differs.

variants.name: dense-compute4
variants.hypothesis: Single-pass dense control with the same FFN projection work as four structured passes; parameter count differs.
